name: Portainer
description: Browse Portainer environments, stacks and containers from DBX, inspect resource usage and read container logs.

versions.releaseNotes: Initial release. Environment, stack and container browsing with health badges, database container discovery with ready-to-use DBX connection parameters, container logs (auto refresh, range, search, download, line selection) and resource statistics. Read-only: every Portainer request is a GET.

zh-CN.name: Portainer
zh-CN.description: 在 DBX 中浏览 Portainer 的环境、堆栈与容器，查看资源占用并阅读容器日志。
